protocol.gate: acc/mcc/auc not worse, brier not materially worse, composite better

recommendations.evidence: MRP acc 0.9721 > baseline 0.9188, but Brier 0.1046 > baseline 0.0722.

recommendations.action: Open a year-fold calibration task focused on the highest-ECE cycle.
